description: A `!` function needing the envelope on a Postgres database compiles clean: the server runtime runs its transaction on a connection reserved from the pool (s475; refused before).
rationale: §19.10.6: "A transaction SHALL run on one connection taken from the pool for it alone, and every statement of the owning request SHALL run on that connection until the transaction ends." Built by s475-boot-pg-envelopes (server-runtime.js txConnection), measured live in compiler/self-host-v2/slice-m4/pg-envelope-s475.test.js.
